# Reference
## Prediction
<details><summary><code>client.prediction.<a href="src/fern/prediction/client.py">predict</a>(...) -> typing.Dict[str, typing.Any]</code></summary>
<dl>
<dd>

#### 📝 Description

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

Submit a document for synchronous parsing and prediction.
</dd>
</dl>
</dd>
</dl>

#### 🔌 Usage

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

```python
from fern import FernApi
from fern.environment import FernApiEnvironment

client = FernApi(
    token="<token>",
    environment=FernApiEnvironment.DEFAULT,
)

client.prediction.predict(
    account="account",
    product="product",
    version="version",
)

```
</dd>
</dl>
</dd>
</dl>

#### ⚙️ Parameters

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

**account:** `str` — Account name or 'mindee' for built-in products.
    
</dd>
</dl>

<dl>
<dd>

**product:** `str` — Product name (e.g., invoices, receipts, passports).
    
</dd>
</dl>

<dl>
<dd>

**version:** `str` — Product version.
    
</dd>
</dl>

<dl>
<dd>

**document:** `typing.Optional[str]` — Base64-encoded document or URL.
    
</dd>
</dl>

<dl>
<dd>

**request_options:** `typing.Optional[RequestOptions]` — Request-specific configuration.
    
</dd>
</dl>
</dd>
</dl>


</dd>
</dl>
</details>
